name: Harborview Family Housing Center
eligibility: Open to families and individuals facing eviction or homelessness in the county.

name: Bridgeway Transitional Shelter
eligibility: Available to single adults and veterans who need temporary emergency shelter.

name: Casa Segura Rental Assistance
eligibility: Serves low-income renters who are behind on rent and at risk of eviction.

name: Little Sprouts Early Learning Fund
eligibility: Provides subsidized childcare vouchers for working parents earning below 200% of the federal poverty line.

name: Sunrise Community Daycare Network
eligibility: Open to families with children under age 6 who need full-day or after-school care.

name: Greenfield Community Food Pantry
eligibility: Open to any household in need of groceries, no proof of income required.

name: Mesa Verde Mobile Meals
eligibility: Delivers free meals to homebound seniors and individuals with disabilities.

name: Riverside Family Nutrition Program
eligibility: Serves families with young children who qualify for WIC or SNAP benefits.

name: NextStep Career Training Institute
eligibility: Open to unemployed or underemployed adults seeking job training and placement services.

name: Horizon Workforce Development Center
eligibility: Serves adults age 18 and older looking for resume help, interview coaching, and job leads.

name: Clearwater Community Health Clinic
eligibility: Provides low-cost medical care to uninsured and underinsured residents regardless of immigration status.

name: Willow Creek Behavioral Health Services
eligibility: Open to residents seeking free or sliding-scale mental health counseling.

name: Fairview Legal Aid Society
eligibility: Offers free legal representation to low-income residents facing housing, family, or immigration cases.

name: Cedar Park Immigrant Justice Clinic
eligibility: Serves immigrants and refugees who need help with visa applications, asylum cases, or citizenship paperwork.
